facts.text: Audrey has four dogs that she takes to the vet, and she plans to bring them one by one in the future due to the chaos of the vet visit.

evidence.quote: I took them all to the vet and got them checked up, it was such a havoc that next time I'll bring them one by one.

facts.text: Audrey's four dogs each have a favorite spot to relax: Pepper on the couch, Pixie in her bed, Precious in her chair, and Panda on his rug.

evidence.quote: Pepper loves lounging on the couch, Pixie always curls up in her bed, Precious has her chair, and Panda loves to relax on his rug!

facts.text: Audrey has a tattoo of her four dogs on her arm, which she got because they mean a lot to her and she wants them with her wherever she goes.

evidence.quote: I got another tattoo of my four dogs on my arm! They really mean a lot to me so I thought it'd be nice to have them with me wherever I go.

facts.text: Andrew shared a photo of Toby, a dog, at his favorite spot, which is a fluffy blanket on the floor.

evidence.quote: Here's Toby at his favorite spot.
a photo of a dog laying on a fluffy blanket on the floor
